questions.question_hi: विद्युत धारा की SI इकाई क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Ampere (A) is SI unit of electric current. Named after André-Marie Ampère.

questions.question_hi: भारत में मताधिकार की न्यूनतम आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • 18 years — 61st Amendment (1988) reduced voting age from 21 to 18.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सात निश्चय' योजना किसके द्वारा शुरू की गई?
questions.explanation_en: • 'Saat Nischay' (7 Resolves) by CM Nitish Kumar — includes toilets, piped water, roads, electricity for all.

questions.question_hi: जल का अणुसूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Water molecule: H₂O (2 hydrogen + 1 oxygen). Polar covalent bonds. Universal solvent.

questions.question_hi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता की खोज कब हुई?
questions.explanation_en: • Harappa discovered 1921 by Daya Ram Sahni. Mohenjo-daro 1922 by R.D. Banerjee. IVC dates ~2600-1900 BCE.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में कौन सी मिट्टी सबसे अधिक पायी जाती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Alluvial soil (Jalodh) covers most of Bihar — deposited by Ganga and tributaries. Very fertile for agriculture.

questions.question_hi: 'लोक अदालत' किस प्रकार की न्यायिक प्रणाली है?
questions.explanation_en: • Lok Adalat = Alternative Dispute Resolution. Under Legal Services Authority Act, 1987. No appeal against its award.

questions.question_hi: प्लाज्मोडियम परजीवी से कौन सा रोग होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Malaria — caused by Plasmodium (vivax, falciparum, malariae, ovale). Transmitted by female Anopheles mosquito.

questions.question_hi: पटना का 'गोलघर' किसने बनवाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Golghar built 1786 by Captain John Garstin under British East India Company as granary after 1770 famine.

questions.question_hi: किसी वस्तु का जड़त्व किस पर निर्भर करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Inertia depends on mass. Newton's First Law: objects resist change in motion proportional to mass.

questions.question_hi: भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य (क्षेत्रफल में)?
questions.explanation_en: • Rajasthan — 342,239 sq km (10.4% of India). Largest by area.

questions.question_hi: 'दीन-ए-इलाही' धर्म किसने चलाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Akbar founded Din-i-Ilahi (1582) — syncretic religion combining elements of Islam, Hinduism, Christianity, Zoroastrianism.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री ग्राम परिवहन योजना' का उद्देश्य?
questions.explanation_en: • Provides 50% subsidy on purchase of 4-wheeler vehicles for rural transport connectivity.

questions.question_hi: ओजोन (O₃) परत को नुकसान पहुँचाने वाला मुख्य रसायन?
questions.explanation_en: • CFCs (Chlorofluorocarbons) — release chlorine atoms that catalytically destroy ozone. Montreal Protocol (1987) banned CFCs.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'आपातकाल' की अधिकतम अवधि कितनी है?

options.hi: कोई सीमा नहीं (संसद की स्वीकृति तक)

questions.explanation_en: • No maximum period. Can be extended indefinitely with Parliament approval every 6 months.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बक्सर' का युद्ध कब हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Battle of Buxar (Oct 22, 1764). British defeated combined forces of Mughal Emperor, Nawab of Bengal, and Nawab of Awadh.

questions.question_hi: विद्युत चुंबकीय प्रेरण के नियम किसने दिए?
questions.explanation_en: • Faraday's Laws of Electromagnetic Induction (1831). Basis of dynamo, transformer, generator.

questions.question_hi: भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Ganga (2,525 km) — longest river entirely in India. Originates at Gomukh (Gangotri glacier).

questions.question_hi: 'डांडी मार्च' का उद्देश्य क्या था?
questions.explanation_en: • Dandi March (Mar 12-Apr 6, 1930): Gandhi walked 390 km to break Salt Law. Start of Civil Disobedience Movement.

questions.question_hi: बिहार राज्य का एक प्रमुख उद्योग क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sugar industry is major in Bihar. Multiple sugar mills in Champaran, Saran. Bihar is major sugarcane producer.

questions.question_hi: मेंडलीव की आवर्त सारणी किस आधार पर है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mendeleev's table (1869) based on atomic weight. Modern table by Moseley (1913) uses atomic number.

questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद शिक्षा का अधिकार देता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Article 21A (added by 86th Amendment, 2002): Free and compulsory education for children 6-14 years. RTE Act 2009.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में कौन सा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान स्थित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Valmiki National Park (West Champaran) — Bihar's only national park. Part of Valmiki Tiger Reserve.

questions.question_hi: ध्वनि की तीव्रता किसमें मापी जाती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Decibel (dB) measures sound intensity/loudness. Normal conversation ~60 dB. Painful >120 dB.

questions.question_hi: 'तमाशा-ए-हिंद' किसकी रचना है?
questions.explanation_en: • Badayuni wrote Muntakhab-ut-Tawarikh. Various works describe India's spectacle. Tamasha-e-Hind is associated with historical accounts.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'आंगनबाड़ी' केंद्रों की संख्या लगभग कितनी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar has approximately 1.15 lakh Anganwadi centers under ICDS (Integrated Child Development Services).

questions.question_hi: किसी पारदर्शी माध्यम में प्रकाश की चाल निर्भर करती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Light speed in medium depends on wavelength/color (refractive index varies). This causes dispersion (rainbow).

questions.question_hi: भारत में नागरिकता प्राप्त करने के कितने तरीके हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • 5 ways: Birth, Descent, Registration, Naturalization, Territory incorporation. Under Citizenship Act 1955.

questions.question_hi: 'सोनपुर मेला' किस लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sonepur Cattle Fair (Sonepur Mela) — Asia's largest cattle fair. Held on Kartik Purnima at Ganga-Gandak confluence.

questions.question_hi: 'वाष्पोत्सर्जन' (Transpiration) पौधे के किस भाग से होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Transpiration mainly through leaves via stomata (90%). Also through lenticels and cuticle.

questions.question_hi: भूकंप की तीव्रता किस पैमाने पर मापी जाती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Richter Scale measures earthquake magnitude (logarithmic). 1-10 scale. Each unit = 10× more amplitude.

questions.question_hi: 'पागल पंथी विद्रोह' किस राज्य में हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Pagal Panthi Rebellion: 1825-50 in Assam (Sherpur, Mymensingh). Led by Tipu. Against zamindars.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'महादलित' शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mahadalit = most marginalized SC groups in Bihar. Special welfare schemes by state government since 2007.

questions.question_hi: मानव शरीर का सबसे कठोर पदार्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tooth Enamel is hardest substance in human body. 96% hydroxyapatite (calcium phosphate mineral).

questions.question_hi: राज्य विधानसभा में अधिकतम कितने सदस्य हो सकते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Maximum 500, minimum 60 members (Art 170). Exception: Sikkim, Goa etc. can have less.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का कौन सा नगर 'लीची नगरी' कहलाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Muzaffarpur = 'Litchi Capital of India'. Shahi Litchi has GI tag. 70%+ of India's litchi from here.

questions.question_hi: प्रकृति में सबसे कठोर पदार्थ कौन सा है?
questions.explanation_en: • Diamond is hardest natural substance (10 on Mohs scale). Made of pure carbon in tetrahedral arrangement.

questions.question_hi: चाणक्य (कौटिल्य) ने कौन सी पुस्तक लिखी?
questions.explanation_en: • Kautilya's Arthashastra — ancient treatise on statecraft, economics, military strategy. Mauryan administration.

questions.question_hi: बिहार दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar Diwas: March 22 — anniversary of Bihar's formation as separate province (1912).

questions.question_hi: किस गैस को 'जैव माड्यूलेटर' कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Nitric Oxide (NO) — biomodulator. Regulates blood pressure, immune function. Nobel Prize 1998 to Furchgott, Ignarro, Murad.

questions.question_hi: भारत में कौन सी 'रिट' (Writ) केवल मौलिक अधिकारों के लिए जारी होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Habeas Corpus specifically targets personal liberty (Fundamental Right). Other writs have broader scope.

questions.question_hi: जयप्रकाश नारायण ने 'संपूर्ण क्रांति' का नारा कब दिया?
questions.explanation_en: • JP Movement (1974) — Total Revolution against corruption of Indira Gandhi government. Led to Emergency 1975.

questions.question_hi: लेंज का नियम किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Lenz's Law: induced EMF opposes the change that causes it. Conservation of energy in electromagnetism.

questions.question_hi: 'सिल्क रूट' (Silk Route) किन देशों को जोड़ता था?
questions.explanation_en: • Ancient Silk Road: China to Rome/Mediterranean through Central Asia. Trade of silk, spices, ideas.

questions.question_hi: बिहार शरीफ किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar Sharif — important Islamic center. Tomb of Makhdoom Shah (Hazrat Maulana Makhdoom Sharfuddin Yahya Maneri).

questions.question_hi: किस प्रकार के लेंस से दूरदृष्टि (Hypermetropia) दोष ठीक होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Convex (converging) lens corrects Hypermetropia (farsightedness). Concave lens corrects Myopia (nearsightedness).

questions.question_hi: संविधान संशोधन प्रक्रिया किस अनुच्छेद में?
questions.explanation_en: • Article 368: Parliament's power to amend Constitution. 3 types: simple majority, special majority, special + state ratification.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'तिरहुत' क्षेत्र में कौन सी भाषा बोली जाती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tirhut region: Maithili language. Includes Darbhanga, Madhubani. Maithili is one of 22 scheduled languages.

questions.question_hi: परमाणु बम किस सिद्धांत पर आधारित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Atom bomb: Nuclear Fission (uncontrolled chain reaction of U-235/Pu-239). H-bomb uses Fusion.

questions.question_hi: 'भाखड़ा-नांगल' बाँध किस नदी पर है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bhakra-Nangal Dam on Sutlej River (Punjab-Himachal border). India's tallest gravity dam (226m).

questions.question_hi: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध कब शुरू हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • WWI: 1914-1918. Trigger: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. India provided soldiers and resources.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'लोक शिकायत निवारण अधिकार अधिनियम' कब लागू?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar Lok Shikayat Nivaran Adhikar Adhiniyam 2016 for time-bound grievance redressal.

questions.question_hi: ग्लोबल वार्मिंग का मुख्य कारण कौन सी गैस है?
questions.explanation_en: • CO₂ is primary greenhouse gas causing global warming. Pre-industrial ~280 ppm, now ~420 ppm.

questions.question_hi: भारत के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Dr. Rajendra Prasad — first President (1950-1962). Only President to serve 2 terms. From Bihar (Siwan).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'विक्रमशिला' विश्वविद्यालय के अवशेष कहाँ हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Vikramashila ruins at Antichak, Kahalgaon, Bhagalpur. Founded by Dharmapala (Pala dynasty, 8th century).

questions.question_hi: मनुष्य के शरीर में सबसे छोटी हड्डी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Stapes (stirrup bone) in middle ear — smallest bone (~3mm). Femur is largest.

questions.question_hi: 'रॉलेट एक्ट' कब पारित हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Rowlatt Act (March 1919) — allowed detention without trial. Led to nationwide protests and Jallianwala Bagh.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'पंचायत राज प्रणाली' कितने स्तरों पर है?
questions.explanation_en: • 3-tier Panchayati Raj: Gram Panchayat (village), Panchayat Samiti (block), Zila Parishad (district).

questions.question_hi: किस ग्रह को 'लाल ग्रह' कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Mars = Red Planet due to iron oxide (rust) on surface. Has 2 moons: Phobos and Deimos.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अंतरराज्यीय परिषद' का गठन किस अनुच्छेद से?
questions.explanation_en: • Article 263: President may establish Inter-State Council for coordination between Centre and States.

questions.question_hi: मौर्य वंश का अंतिम शासक कौन था?
questions.explanation_en: • Brihadratha — last Mauryan emperor. Assassinated by his commander Pushyamitra Shunga (185 BCE).

questions.question_hi: प्रोटीन का पाचन कहाँ शुरू होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Protein digestion starts in stomach by pepsin enzyme (activated by HCl). Continues in small intestine by trypsin.

questions.question_hi: 'काला सागर' किन देशों के बीच है?
questions.explanation_en: • Black Sea between Europe and Asia. Bordered by Turkey, Romania, Bulgaria, Ukraine, Georgia, Russia.

questions.question_hi: 'प्लासी का युद्ध' कब हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Battle of Plassey: June 23, 1757. Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah. Beginning of British rule in India.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में कृषि क्षेत्र में कुल रोजगार का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत है?
questions.explanation_en: • Agriculture employs ~75% of Bihar's workforce, though contributes ~20% to GSDP. High dependence.

questions.question_hi: किस रोग को 'काली मौत' (Black Death) कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Plague (Black Death) — caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria. 14th century pandemic killed ~75-200 million.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'उच्चतम न्यायालय' के न्यायाधीश की सेवानिवृत्ति आयु?
questions.explanation_en: • SC judge retires at 65 years. HC judge retires at 62 years. CJI also 65.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'कोसी' नदी को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Kosi = 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to devastating floods changing course frequently. Now controlled by Kosi Barrage.

questions.question_hi: रेडियो तरंगें किस प्रकार की तरंगें हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Radio waves are electromagnetic waves (longest wavelength in EM spectrum). Travel at speed of light.

questions.question_hi: 'सुभाष चंद्र बोस' ने INA (आजाद हिंद फौज) कहाँ संगठित किया?
questions.explanation_en: • INA organized in Singapore (1943). Bose gave 'Give me blood, I'll give you freedom'. March on Imphal/Kohima.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का सबसे बड़ा शहर (जनसंख्या) कौन सा है?
questions.explanation_en: • Patna — largest city and capital. Population ~20 lakh (2011). Major urban agglomeration.

questions.question_hi: पौधों में श्वसन किस गैस को लेता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Plants respire using O₂ (like animals). Photosynthesis uses CO₂. Both processes occur simultaneously in day.

questions.question_hi: 'राज्यपाल' की नियुक्ति किस अनुच्छेद से?
questions.explanation_en: • Art 155: Governor appointed by President. Art 153: Governor for each state. Art 156: term 5 years (pleasure of President).

questions.question_hi: 'पाटलिपुत्र' (पटना) को किसने अपनी राजधानी बनाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Udayin (Udayabhadra) moved capital from Rajgir to Pataliputra (~460 BCE). Chandragupta Maurya later made it grand.

questions.question_hi: 'थर्मामीटर' में कौन सा तरल प्रयोग होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mercury thermometer (clinical/lab). Alcohol thermometer (sub-zero temps). Both used depending on application.

questions.question_hi: भारत का कौन सा राज्य सर्वाधिक राज्यों से सीमा बनाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Uttar Pradesh borders 9 states/UTs — most of any Indian state. MP touches 5 states.

questions.question_hi: 'सती प्रथा निषेध' कानून किसने बनाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Lord William Bentinck — Regulation XVII (1829) abolished Sati. Backed by Raja Ram Mohan Roy.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'तटबंध' (Embankment) किस नदी के कारण अधिक बनाए गए?
questions.explanation_en: • Kosi river embankments are extensive due to frequent devastating floods and course changes.

questions.question_hi: 'अम्ल वर्षा' में कौन सा अम्ल होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Acid rain contains sulfuric acid and nitric acid. Formed from SO₂ and NOₓ emissions reacting with water vapor.

questions.question_hi: 'अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति (अत्याचार निवारण) अधिनियम' कब?
questions.explanation_en: • SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989. Amended 2015. Strengthened protections for SC/ST.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बिहार स्कूल ऑफ योगा' कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar School of Yoga (BSY) in Munger. Founded by Swami Satyananda Saraswati (1963). World-famous yoga institution.

questions.question_hi: 'जीवाश्म ईंधन' (Fossil Fuel) में क्या शामिल है?
questions.explanation_en: • Fossil fuels: Coal, Petroleum, Natural Gas. Formed from ancient organic matter over millions of years. Non-renewable.

questions.question_hi: भारत में सबसे अधिक वर्षा कहाँ होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mawsynram (Meghalaya) — wettest place on earth (~11,871 mm avg). Nearby Cherrapunji is 2nd wettest.

questions.question_hi: 'वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट' किसने लागू किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Lord Lytton — Vernacular Press Act 1878. Restricted Indian language press. Repealed by Lord Ripon 1882.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'नालंदा' को UNESCO विश्व धरोहर कब घोषित किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Nalanda Mahavihara declared UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016. Archaeological ruins of ancient university.

questions.question_hi: किस विटामिन की कमी से रक्तस्राव (Scurvy) होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Scurvy — Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) deficiency. Symptoms: bleeding gums, skin spots, weakness.

questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान में 'धर्मनिरपेक्षता' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Secularism in India = Sarva Dharma Samabhava (equal respect for all religions). State has no official religion.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का कौन सा जिला सबसे बड़ा (क्षेत्रफल) है?
questions.explanation_en: • West Champaran — largest district by area (5,228 sq km). Followed by Gaya and Rohtas.

questions.question_hi: 'बायोगैस' में मुख्य रूप से कौन सी गैस होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Biogas: ~60% Methane (CH₄) + ~40% CO₂. Produced by anaerobic digestion of organic matter.

questions.question_hi: अशोक ने कलिंग युद्ध के बाद क्या अपनाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Ashoka adopted Buddhism after Kalinga War (~261 BCE). Horrors of war changed him. Promoted Dhamma (non-violence, tolerance).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बाढ़ प्रबंधन' के लिए कौन सा विभाग जिम्मेदार है?
questions.explanation_en: • Water Resources Department handles flood management, embankment maintenance, and disaster mitigation in Bihar.

questions.question_hi: किस तत्व का प्रतीक 'Fe' है?
questions.explanation_en: • Fe = Iron (from Latin 'Ferrum'). Atomic number 26. Most abundant metal in Earth's core.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'वित्त आयोग' का गठन किस अनुच्छेद से?
questions.explanation_en: • Art 280: President constitutes Finance Commission every 5 years. Recommends tax distribution between Centre and States.

questions.question_hi: शेरशाह सूरी का मकबरा कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sher Shah Suri's tomb in Sasaram (Rohtas, Bihar). Built 1545. Masterpiece of Indo-Islamic architecture in an artificial lake.

questions.question_hi: 'RNA' में कौन सा शर्करा होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • RNA contains Ribose sugar. DNA contains Deoxyribose (one less oxygen). RNA also has Uracil instead of Thymine.

questions.question_hi: भारत के पूर्वी तट को क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Coromandel Coast = eastern coast (TN, AP). Malabar = western coast (Kerala). Konkan = western (Maharashtra, Goa).

questions.question_hi: 'पंचशील सिद्धांत' (Panchsheel) किन देशों ने अपनाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Panchsheel (Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence): India-China agreement 1954. Promoted by Nehru and Zhou Enlai.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मखाना' (Fox Nut) का सबसे अधिक उत्पादन कहाँ होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Darbhanga and Madhubani districts — largest Makhana producers. Bihar produces 90% of India's Makhana.

questions.question_hi: किस ग्रह के सबसे अधिक उपग्रह हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Saturn has most known moons (~146 as of 2024). Jupiter has ~95. Saturn overtook Jupiter recently.

questions.question_hi: 'मूल कर्तव्य' (Fundamental Duties) किस भाग में हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Part IVA (Art 51A): 11 Fundamental Duties. Added by 42nd Amendment (1976). Not justiciable.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'राजगीर' का महत्व क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Rajgir (Rajagriha) — ancient capital of Magadha before Pataliputra. First Buddhist Council held here. Hot springs.

questions.question_hi: जल का क्वथनांक (Boiling Point) कितना है?
questions.explanation_en: • Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm). Higher altitude = lower boiling point.

questions.question_hi: 'मुगल साम्राज्य' का संस्थापक कौन था?
questions.explanation_en: • Babur founded Mughal Empire in 1526 after Battle of Panipat. Defeated Ibrahim Lodi.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क योजना' (PMGSY) का लाभ?
questions.explanation_en: • PMGSY: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected villages. Bihar has been major beneficiary.

questions.question_hi: 'अम्लराज' (Aqua Regia) किन अम्लों का मिश्रण है?
questions.explanation_en: • Aqua Regia = 3 parts HCl + 1 part HNO₃. Can dissolve gold and platinum. Name means 'Royal Water'.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'निर्वाचन आयोग' कितने सदस्यीय है?
questions.explanation_en: • Election Commission: CEC + 2 Election Commissioners = 3 members. Multi-member since 1993.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'चंपारण' जिले में नील की खेती के विरुद्ध आंदोलन किसने चलाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Gandhi led Champaran Movement (1917) against Tinkathia system of indigo planters. His first satyagraha in India.

questions.question_hi: 'प्रकाश संश्लेषण' (Photosynthesis) का सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Photosynthesis: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ (in presence of sunlight and chlorophyll).

questions.question_hi: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा महासागर कौन सा है?
questions.explanation_en: • Pacific Ocean — largest (165.25 million km²). Covers more than all land areas combined.

questions.question_hi: भारत को 'सोने की चिड़िया' क्यों कहा जाता था?
questions.explanation_en: • India was called 'Golden Bird' (Sone ki Chidiya) due to its enormous wealth, trade, and prosperity in ancient/medieval times.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री अल्पसंख्यक रोजगार ऋण योजना' किसके लिए है?
questions.explanation_en: • For minority communities — provides loan up to ₹5 lakh at 5% interest for self-employment.

questions.question_hi: किस विटामिन को 'सनशाइन विटामिन' कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Vitamin D = Sunshine Vitamin. Synthesized in skin by UV-B sunlight. Essential for calcium absorption, bone health.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'प्रधानमंत्री' पद के लिए न्यूनतम आयु?
questions.explanation_en: • PM must be member of Lok Sabha (25 years) or Rajya Sabha (30 years). Effectively 25 years minimum.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'फल्गु' नदी कहाँ बहती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Phalgu (Niranjana) River flows through Gaya. Important for Hindu rituals (Pind Daan). Mentioned in Ramayana.

questions.question_hi: 'न्यूटन के गति के तीसरे नियम' का सार क्या है?

options.hi: प्रत्येक क्रिया की समान और विपरीत प्रतिक्रिया

questions.explanation_en: • Newton's 3rd Law: Every action has equal and opposite reaction. Explains rocket propulsion, walking, etc.

questions.question_hi: किस मुगल शासक ने 'ताजमहल' बनवाया?
questions.explanation_en: • Shah Jahan built Taj Mahal (1632-1653) in memory of wife Mumtaz Mahal. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'समग्र शिक्षा अभियान' का उद्देश्य?

options.hi: प्राथमिक से माध्यमिक शिक्षा का सर्वव्यापीकरण

questions.explanation_en: • Samagra Shiksha: integrated scheme from pre-school to class 12. Covers SSA + RMSA + Teacher Education.

questions.question_hi: 'ट्रांसफॉर्मर' किस सिद्धांत पर काम करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Transformer works on Electromagnetic Induction (Faraday's Law). Steps up/down AC voltage. Only works with AC.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग' (NHRC) के अध्यक्ष कौन हो सकते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • NHRC Chairman: retired Chief Justice of India. Statutory body under Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.

questions.question_hi: बुद्ध को ज्ञान प्राप्ति कहाँ हुई?
questions.explanation_en: • Bodh Gaya (Bihar) — under Bodhi tree. Attained enlightenment at age 35. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.question_hi: 'pH' स्केल में pH 7 क्या दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • pH 7 = Neutral (pure water). Below 7 = acidic. Above 7 = basic/alkaline. Scale runs 0-14.

questions.question_hi: 'पश्चिमी घाट' को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Western Ghats = Sahyadri. UNESCO World Heritage (2012). Biodiversity hotspot along western coast.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी' कब आई?
questions.explanation_en: • British East India Company established 1600. First factory at Surat 1613. Gradually expanded trade and political control.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र' (SEZ) कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Hajipur has Export Processing Zone (now SEZ). FMCG Park also located here.

questions.question_hi: मानव रक्त का रंग लाल क्यों होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Hemoglobin (iron-containing protein in RBCs) gives blood red color. Oxygenated = bright red, deoxygenated = dark red.

questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान सभा के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Dr. Rajendra Prasad — Chairman of Constituent Assembly (Dec 11, 1946). Ambedkar chaired Drafting Committee.

questions.question_hi: जैन धर्म के 24वें तीर्थंकर कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Mahavira (Vardhamana) — 24th and last Tirthankara. Born in Vaishali (Bihar). Founded Jainism.

questions.question_hi: 'जीपीएस' (GPS) किस तकनीक पर आधारित है?
questions.explanation_en: • GPS: satellite-based navigation. 24+ satellites in orbit. Accuracy within meters. Developed by USA (NAVSTAR).

questions.question_hi: 'मृत सागर' (Dead Sea) किन देशों की सीमा पर है?
questions.explanation_en: • Dead Sea between Israel and Jordan. Lowest point on Earth (-430m). So salty (34%) that you float.

questions.question_hi: 'तीसरी कर्णाटक युद्ध' (Third Carnatic War) का परिणाम?
questions.explanation_en: • Third Carnatic War (1756-63): British victory. Treaty of Paris 1763. French lost almost all territories in India.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में लोकसभा की कुल कितनी सीटें हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar has 40 Lok Sabha seats (after delimitation). 6 reserved for SC. Major electoral state.

questions.question_hi: 'क्वार्ट्ज' किस खनिज से बना होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Quartz = SiO₂ (Silicon Dioxide). Most abundant mineral in Earth's crust. Used in watches, glass.

questions.question_hi: 'अनुच्छेद 343' किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Art 343: Hindi in Devanagari script = official language of Union. English continued for first 15 years.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का कौन सा क्षेत्र 'अंग' प्रदेश कहलाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Anga Pradesh = eastern Bihar (Bhagalpur, Munger, Banka). Ancient kingdom. Champa was its capital.

questions.question_hi: 'एक हॉर्स पावर' बराबर कितने वाट?
questions.explanation_en: • 1 Horsepower = 746 Watts. Unit of power defined by James Watt. Used for engines and motors.

questions.question_hi: 'भागवत गीता' किस ग्रंथ का भाग है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bhagavad Gita is part of Mahabharata (Bhishma Parva). 18 chapters, 700 verses. Krishna's teachings to Arjuna.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'प्रखंड' (Block) की कुल संख्या लगभग कितनी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar has 534 blocks (CD blocks). Administrative units below district level.

questions.question_hi: 'प्लास्टिक' कैसा पदार्थ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Plastic is non-biodegradable (takes 500-1000 years). Major environmental concern. Some biodegradable plastics now exist.

questions.question_hi: भारत का 'राष्ट्रगान' (National Anthem) कब अपनाया गया?
questions.explanation_en: • 'Jana Gana Mana' adopted as National Anthem on Jan 24, 1950. Written by Rabindranath Tagore (1911).

questions.question_hi: 'पावापुरी' किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Pawapuri (Nalanda, Bihar) — Mahavira attained Nirvana (~527 BCE). Jalmandir temple in middle of lotus pond.

questions.question_hi: किस धातु को 'तरल धातु' कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Mercury (Hg) — only metal liquid at room temperature (melting point -39°C). Used in thermometers, barometers.

questions.question_hi: 'सुंडा जलसंधि' किन द्वीपों के बीच है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sunda Strait between Sumatra and Java (Indonesia). Connects Java Sea with Indian Ocean.

questions.question_hi: 'खजुराहो' के मंदिर किस वंश ने बनवाए?
questions.explanation_en: • Chandela dynasty built Khajuraho Temples (950-1050 CE). UNESCO Heritage. Known for erotic sculptures. Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'e-लाभार्थी' पोर्टल किसके लिए है?
questions.explanation_en: • e-Labharthi portal for direct benefit transfer of social security pensions (old age, widow, disability).

questions.question_hi: 'LED' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • LED = Light Emitting Diode. Semiconductor device. Energy efficient, long-lasting. Replaced bulbs.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'RTI' (सूचना का अधिकार) अधिनियम कब लागू?
questions.explanation_en: • RTI Act 2005 (Oct 12). Citizens can request information from public authorities. 30 days response time.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'गंगा दियारा' क्षेत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Diara = flood-prone riverine areas along Ganga. Fertile but vulnerable. Unique agro-ecology.

questions.question_hi: 'संवेग' (Momentum) का सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Momentum p = mass × velocity. Vector quantity. Conservation of momentum: total momentum before = after collision.

questions.question_hi: 'विजयनगर साम्राज्य' की स्थापना किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • Harihara I and Bukka I founded Vijayanagara Empire (1336). Capital: Hampi. Krishnadevaraya was greatest ruler.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'आयुष्मान भारत' योजना के तहत कितने लाख तक का स्वास्थ्य बीमा?
questions.explanation_en: • Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY): ₹5 lakh health insurance per family per year. Free treatment in empanelled hospitals.

questions.question_hi: किस अंग को 'शरीर का रक्षक' कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • WBCs (White Blood Cells/Leukocytes) = soldiers of body. Fight infections. Part of immune system.

questions.question_hi: 'NITI आयोग' ने किसका स्थान लिया?
questions.explanation_en: • NITI Aayog replaced Planning Commission on Jan 1, 2015. Think tank for cooperative federalism.

questions.question_hi: 'नवादा' जिले में कौन सा प्राचीन स्थल है?
questions.explanation_en: • Barabar Caves (Nagarjuni Hills) in Jehanabad (near Nawada). Oldest rock-cut caves in India. Mauryan period.

questions.question_hi: 'पॅराशूट' किस सिद्धांत पर काम करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Parachute uses air resistance (drag) to slow descent. Large surface area increases drag force.

questions.question_hi: भारत में सबसे लंबी तटरेखा वाला राज्य?
questions.explanation_en: • Gujarat has longest coastline (~1,600 km). Followed by Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question_hi: 'बंगाल का पहला गवर्नर जनरल' कौन था?
questions.explanation_en: • Warren Hastings — first Governor-General of Bengal (1772-1785). Established Asiatic Society. Impeached by Parliament.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'विकास मित्र' (Block Development Officer) का कार्य?
questions.explanation_en: • BDO (Vikas Mitra) is responsible for implementing development programs at block level.

questions.question_hi: किस गैस से CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) बनती है?
questions.explanation_en: • CNG is mainly Methane (CH₄) — compressed to less than 1% of volume. Cleaner fuel than petrol/diesel.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'आरक्षण' की अधिकतम सीमा कितनी है?
questions.explanation_en: • 50% upper limit set by Indira Sawhney case (1992). Some states have exceeded via Constitutional amendment.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बरौनी' किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Barauni Oil Refinery (IOCL) — established 1964. Processes crude oil from Assam. Major industrial center.

questions.question_hi: 'अल्ट्रासाउंड' किस प्रकार की तरंगें हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Ultrasound = sound waves above 20,000 Hz (human audible range 20-20,000 Hz). Used in medical imaging, cleaning.

questions.question_hi: 'मोंटेग्यू-चेम्सफोर्ड सुधार' कब लागू हुए?
questions.explanation_en: • Indian Councils Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms). Introduced Dyarchy at provincial level.

questions.question_hi: बिहार राज्य खाद्य आयोग का कार्य क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar State Food Commission monitors Public Distribution System (PDS) and food security under NFSA.

questions.question_hi: 'आवर्त सारणी' में कुल कितने समूह (Groups) हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Modern Periodic Table has 18 Groups (columns) and 7 Periods (rows). 118 elements total.

questions.question_hi: 'राज्य मानवाधिकार आयोग' के अध्यक्ष कौन होते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • SHRC Chairman: retired Chief Justice of High Court. Appointed by Governor on recommendation of committee.

questions.question_hi: 'बिहार विभूति' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha — 'Bihar Vibhuti'. First Deputy CM and Finance Minister of Bihar. Freedom fighter.

questions.question_hi: कौन सा दर्पण वाहनों के पीछे देखने के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Convex mirror for rear-view — provides wider field of view. Always forms virtual, diminished, erect image.

questions.question_hi: 'नर्मदा' नदी किस सागर में गिरती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Narmada flows westward into Arabian Sea (Gulf of Khambhat). Rift valley river. One of 7 holy rivers.

questions.question_hi: 'बर्मा' (म्यांमार) को भारत से कब अलग किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Burma separated from India in 1937 under Government of India Act 1935. Became independent 1948.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'दीदी की रसोई' किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Community kitchen initiative for providing nutritious meals. Part of women's self-help group empowerment.

questions.question_hi: किसने 'इलेक्ट्रॉन' की खोज की?
questions.explanation_en: • J.J. Thomson discovered electron (1897) using cathode ray tube. Proposed 'Plum Pudding' model. Nobel 1906.

questions.question_hi: भारत में किस संवैधानिक निकाय के सदस्य को 'ने बदला जा सकता और ने हटाया'?
questions.explanation_en: • Finance Commission is ad-hoc body. Members can't be removed during term. UPSC/CAG have removal procedures.

questions.question_hi: 'गंडक' नदी का उद्गम कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Gandak originates near Annapurna range, Nepal. Enters Bihar at Triveni Sangam. Major north Bihar river.

questions.question_hi: 'सोलर सेल' किस सिद्धांत पर काम करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Solar cell: Photovoltaic Effect. Light photons knock electrons free in semiconductor (silicon). Direct conversion of sunlight to electricity.

questions.question_hi: 'कबीर' किस संत परंपरा से संबंधित थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Kabir — Nirguna Bhakti (formless God). Rejected idol worship, caste. Dohas (couplets) still popular. Guru: Ramananda.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'जीविका' (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Project) का उद्देश्य?
questions.explanation_en: • JEEViKA (BRLPS): Bihar's flagship rural livelihoods program. Women's SHGs for poverty reduction. World Bank supported.

questions.question_hi: 'जड़त्वीय नौवहन' (Inertial Navigation) किसमें प्रयुक्त होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Inertial Navigation System: uses accelerometers/gyroscopes. No external reference needed. Used in aircraft, submarines, missiles.

questions.question_hi: 'मूल संविधान' में कितने अनुच्छेद थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Original Constitution: 395 Articles, 22 Parts, 8 Schedules. Now ~470 articles after amendments.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'चेरो विद्रोह' कब हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Chero Rebellion (1800-1819) in Palamu (now Jharkhand). Against British revenue demands. Led by Bhukhan Singh.

questions.question_hi: 'मधुमेह' (Diabetes) किस हार्मोन की कमी से होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Insulin (from Pancreas beta cells). Type 1: no insulin. Type 2: insulin resistance. Controls blood sugar.

questions.question_hi: 'कृष्णा' नदी का उद्गम कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Krishna originates at Mahabaleshwar (Maharashtra). Second longest peninsular river. Joins Bay of Bengal.

questions.question_hi: 'ऋग्वेद' में कुल कितने सूक्त हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Rigveda has 1028 suktas (hymns) in 10 mandalas. Oldest religious text. Composed ~1500-1200 BCE.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री बालक/बालिका साइकिल योजना' का उद्देश्य?
questions.explanation_en: • Free bicycle to class 9 students (both boys and girls) to encourage school attendance. Reduced dropout rates significantly.

questions.question_hi: 'बेरी-बेरी' रोग किस विटामिन की कमी से?
questions.explanation_en: • Beriberi — Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) deficiency. Affects nervous system and heart. Found in wholegrain, nuts.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'उपराष्ट्रपति' राज्यसभा में किस हैसियत से कार्य करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Vice President serves as Chairman of Rajya Sabha (ex-officio). Not a member — can't vote except in tie.

questions.question_hi: 'मंदार हिल' (बौंसी) किस जिले में है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mandar Hill in Banka district. Associated with Samudra Manthan (churning of ocean) legend. Jain/Hindu pilgrimage.

questions.question_hi: 'वायुमंडल' की सबसे निचली परत कौन सी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Troposphere — lowest layer, 0-12 km. Weather occurs here. Temperature decreases with altitude.

questions.question_hi: भारत के किस राज्य में 'जोग जलप्रपात' स्थित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Jog Falls in Karnataka on Sharavathi River. India's 2nd highest plunge waterfall (253m).

questions.question_hi: 'पुराणों' की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation_en: • 18 Mahapuranas. Main: Vishnu, Bhagavata, Shiva, Markandeya, Matsya, Vayu. Written in Sanskrit.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुजफ्फरपुर' किस फल के लिए प्रसिद्ध?
questions.explanation_en: • Muzaffarpur famous for Shahi Litchi. GI tagged. Major production center. Exported worldwide.

questions.question_hi: 'LED' टीवी में L किसके लिए है?
questions.explanation_en: • LED = Light Emitting Diode. LED TVs use LED backlighting for LCD panels. Not same as OLED.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'संसद' के कितने सदन हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • 2 Houses: Lok Sabha (Lower, 545 seats) and Rajya Sabha (Upper, 245 seats). Bicameral legislature.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'कावर झील' (Kabar Lake) कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Kabar Lake (Kanwar Lake) in Begusarai — Asia's largest freshwater oxbow lake. Ramsar site. Important wetland.

questions.question_hi: 'RADAR' का पूर्ण रूप?
questions.explanation_en: • RADAR: Radio Detection And Ranging. Uses radio waves to detect objects, determine distance, speed. Invented WWII.

questions.question_hi: भारत का प्रथम 'वायसराय' कौन था?
questions.explanation_en: • Lord Canning — first Viceroy of India (1858-1862) after Government of India Act 1858 ended Company rule.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'नंदघर' (Nand Ghar) किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Nand Ghar: modernized Anganwadi centers. Solar powered, digital learning, nutrition. Vedanta Foundation initiative.

questions.question_hi: किसके द्वारा रक्त समूह (Blood Group) की खोज की गई?
questions.explanation_en: • Karl Landsteiner discovered blood groups (A, B, O) in 1900. Nobel Prize 1930. AB discovered later.

questions.question_hi: 'GST' कब लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • GST (Goods and Services Tax) launched July 1, 2017. 101st Constitutional Amendment. 'One Nation One Tax'.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'संथाल विद्रोह' (Hul) कब हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Santhal Rebellion (Hul) 1855-56. Led by Sidhu-Kanhu brothers. Against zamindars, moneylenders in Rajmahal Hills.

questions.question_hi: किस ग्रह को 'भोर का तारा' (Morning Star) कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Venus = Morning/Evening Star. Brightest planet visible from Earth. Also called Shukra Tara.

questions.question_hi: विश्व का सबसे ऊँचा जलप्रपात कौन सा है?
questions.explanation_en: • Angel Falls (Venezuela) — 979m, world's highest uninterrupted waterfall. Named after Jimmy Angel.

questions.question_hi: 'भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस' का प्रथम अधिवेशन कहाँ हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • First INC session: Bombay (Dec 1885). 72 delegates. President: W.C. Bonnerjee. Founded by A.O. Hume.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'कृषि रोड मैप' (Agriculture Road Map) किसने शुरू किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar Agricultural Road Map launched 2008-09 by State govt. Focus on rainbow revolution, crop diversification.

questions.question_hi: 'LPG' में कौन सी गैसें होती हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • LPG = Liquefied Petroleum Gas: Butane + Propane. Used for cooking. Stored as liquid under pressure.

questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान की 'आत्मा' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Preamble = 'Soul of Constitution' (as per Thakurdas Bhargava). Key: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सोन' नदी का उद्गम कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Son River originates near Amarkantak (MP). Flows through Bihar. Tributary of Ganga. Major south Bihar river.

questions.question_hi: 'एंजाइम' क्या होते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Enzymes are biological catalysts (mostly proteins). Speed up reactions without being consumed. Lock-and-key model.

questions.question_hi: 'चार्टर एक्ट 1813' का महत्व क्या था?
questions.explanation_en: • Charter Act 1813: ended Company trade monopoly (except tea/China). Allowed Christian missionaries to enter India. ₹1 lakh for education.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'ताल-मखाना' (Fox Nut/Euryale ferox) किस परिवार का पौधा है?
questions.explanation_en: • Euryale ferox (Makhana) belongs to Nymphaeaceae (water lily family). Aquatic plant grown in stagnant water.

questions.question_hi: 'न्यूट्रॉन' की खोज किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • James Chadwick discovered neutron (1932). Nobel Prize 1935. Neutral particle in nucleus.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग' किस अनुच्छेद से?
questions.explanation_en: • Art 338: National Commission for Scheduled Castes. Constitutional body. Investigates complaints, monitors safeguards.

questions.question_hi: 'बिहार केसरी' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sri Krishna Sinha = 'Bihar Kesari'. First CM of Bihar (1946-1961). Longest serving CM. Key role in independence.

questions.question_hi: किस प्रकार की ऊर्जा बाँध में संग्रहीत जल में होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Potential Energy (gravitational). PE = mgh. When released, converts to kinetic energy, then to electrical energy via turbines.

questions.question_hi: 'तीस्ता' नदी किस राज्य में बहती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Teesta River flows through Sikkim and West Bengal. Originates from Tso Lhamo Lake. India-Bangladesh water dispute.

questions.question_hi: 'चोल वंश' का सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक?
questions.explanation_en: • Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE) — greatest Chola ruler. Built Brihadeeswarar Temple. Conquered Sri Lanka, Maldives.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'कुपोषण' दूर करने के लिए कौन सा कार्यक्रम चलाया जा रहा है?
questions.explanation_en: • POSHAN (PM's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nutrition) Abhiyaan — targets malnutrition in children and women.

questions.question_hi: 'कार्बन डेटिंग' किसके लिए प्रयोग होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Carbon-14 dating: determines age of organic materials up to ~50,000 years. C-14 half-life = 5,730 years.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'त्रिस्तरीय पंचायत राज' की सिफारिश किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended 3-tier Panchayati Raj. Implemented first in Rajasthan (1959).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'वाल्मीकि टाइगर रिजर्व' कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Valmiki Tiger Reserve in West Champaran — Bihar's only tiger reserve. Part of Chitwan-Valmiki landscape.

questions.question_hi: 'फोटॉन' किसकी इकाई है?
questions.explanation_en: • Photon = quantum of light energy. E = hf (Planck's equation). Massless particle. Both wave and particle nature.

questions.question_hi: 'खुदीराम बोस' कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Khudiram Bose — youngest revolutionary hanged by British (age 18) in 1908. Threw bomb at Muzaffarpur (Bihar).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बाँध प्रबंधन' में FMISC का पूर्ण रूप?
questions.explanation_en: • FMISC: Flood Management Improvement Support Centre. World Bank funded project for Bihar flood management.

questions.question_hi: 'केप्लर के ग्रहीय गति नियम' किससे संबंधित हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion: 1) Elliptical orbits, 2) Equal areas in equal times, 3) T²∝a³.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'संविधान दिवस' कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Constitution Day: Nov 26. Constitution adopted Nov 26, 1949. Came into effect Jan 26, 1950 (Republic Day).

questions.question_hi: बिहार का 'केसरिया स्तूप' किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?

options.hi: विश्व का सबसे ऊँचा बौद्ध स्तूप

questions.explanation_en: • Kesariya Stupa (East Champaran) — world's tallest Buddhist stupa (~104 ft). Built by Ashoka. Mentioned by Xuanzang.

questions.question_hi: 'गैल्वेनोमीटर' किसे मापता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Galvanometer detects and measures small electric currents. Used as ammeter/voltmeter with modifications.

questions.question_hi: 'पैंगोंग झील' किस राज्य/UT में है?
questions.explanation_en: • Pangong Tso in Ladakh. 134 km long, extends into China. ~4,350m altitude. Endorheic (no outlet) lake.

questions.question_hi: 'अमृतसर की संधि' (1809) किनके बीच हुई?
questions.explanation_en: • Treaty of Amritsar 1809: British and Ranjit Singh. Fixed Sutlej as boundary. Sikh Empire confined to north.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बांग्लादेश' से सीमा लगती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar does NOT share border with Bangladesh. Borders: Nepal (north), UP (west), Jharkhand (south), WB (east).

questions.question_hi: 'प्रिज्म' से सफेद प्रकाश गुजरने पर क्या होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • White light disperses into 7 colors (VIBGYOR) through prism. Different wavelengths refract at different angles.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'राज्य का प्रमुख' कौन होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Governor = Constitutional Head of State. Appointed by President. CM is head of government (real power).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'ताल' (Tal) क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tal = low-lying waterlogged area. Common in Bihar's Ganga-Gandak region. Floods annually.

questions.question_hi: 'BCG' टीका किस रोग के लिए है?
questions.explanation_en: • BCG (Bacillus Calmette-Guérin) vaccine for Tuberculosis. Given at birth in India. Provides partial protection.

questions.question_hi: 'मुगल साम्राज्य' का अंतिम शासक कौन था?
questions.explanation_en: • Bahadur Shah Zafar (1837-1857) — last Mughal emperor. Exiled to Rangoon after 1857. Died 1862.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'पटना मेट्रो' की योजना किस चरण में है?
questions.explanation_en: • Patna Metro Rail project approved. 2 corridors planned (~31 km). Under construction/planning phase.

questions.question_hi: 'तांबा' (Copper) का रासायनिक प्रतीक?
questions.explanation_en: • Cu = Copper (from Latin 'Cuprum'). Atomic number 29. Excellent conductor. Used in wiring, coins.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अंतर्राज्यीय जल विवाद' का निपटारा कौन करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Inter-State Water Disputes Tribunal under Art 262 and River Water Disputes Act 1956. SC has no jurisdiction.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'प्रथम रेल लाइन' कब बिछाई गई?
questions.explanation_en: • First railway in Bihar: 1862 (East Indian Railway). Connected Patna to Calcutta. Major transport revolution.

questions.question_hi: 'अश्रु गैस' (Tear Gas) का रासायनिक नाम?
questions.explanation_en: • Chloroacetophenone (CN) or CS gas (2-chlorobenzalmalononitrile). Causes tears, burning sensation. Riot control.

questions.question_hi: 'कच्छ का रण' किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation_en: • Rann of Kutch in Gujarat. Salt marshes/desert. Great Rann and Little Rann. Famous Rann Utsav festival.

questions.question_hi: 'सांची स्तूप' किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sanchi Stupa in Madhya Pradesh. Built by Ashoka (3rd century BCE). UNESCO World Heritage. Famous gateways (toranas).

questions.question_hi: बिहार सरकार की 'पथ परिवहन निगम' (BSRTC) का मुख्यालय?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) headquartered in Patna. Operates inter-city bus services.

questions.question_hi: 'लिट्मस पेपर' किसका सूचक है?
questions.explanation_en: • Litmus paper: acid-base indicator. Red litmus → blue in base. Blue litmus → red in acid. From lichen.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'शिक्षा' किस सूची का विषय है?
questions.explanation_en: • Education in Concurrent List (42nd Amendment, 1976). Earlier in State List. Both Centre and States can legislate.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'दरभंगा' किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Darbhanga: heart of Mithila culture. Maithili language center. Famous Darbhanga Raj. Mithila painting. University.

questions.question_hi: 'सोनार' (SONAR) किस माध्यम में काम करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • SONAR (Sound Navigation And Ranging) uses sound waves in water. Detects submarines, ocean depth. Ultrasonic waves.

questions.question_hi: 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना कब और कहाँ?
questions.explanation_en: • Brahmo Samaj: 1828 in Calcutta by Raja Ram Mohan Roy. Monotheistic reform movement. Against sati, caste.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'महालेखाकार' (AG) कार्यालय कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Accountant General (AG) office in Patna. Under CAG. Audits Bihar state government accounts.

questions.question_hi: 'स्टैनलेस स्टील' किन धातुओं का मिश्रधातु है?
questions.explanation_en: • Stainless Steel: Iron + Chromium (min 10.5%) + Nickel. Corrosion resistant. Used in utensils, surgical instruments.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'जनगणना' कितने वर्षों में होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Census every 10 years. First: 1872 (non-synchronous), 1881 (first complete). 2011 was latest. 2021 postponed.

questions.question_hi: 'बोधगया मंदिर अधिनियम' कब पारित?
questions.explanation_en: • Bodh Gaya Temple Act 1949: management of Mahabodhi Temple. Advisory board of Hindus and Buddhists.

questions.question_hi: 'पेट्रोलियम' को किस नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Petroleum = 'Black Gold' due to its economic value. Crude oil. Major energy source. Found in sedimentary rocks.

questions.question_hi: विश्व की सबसे गहरी खाई कौन सी है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mariana Trench: ~11,034m deep (Challenger Deep). Pacific Ocean. Deepest point on Earth.

questions.question_hi: 'चंपारण सत्याग्रह' में गांधी के साथ कौन से बिहारी नेता?
questions.explanation_en: • Dr. Rajendra Prasad and Brajkishore Prasad were key Bihar leaders who joined Gandhi in Champaran Satyagraha.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'विधानसभा' की कुल सीटें?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar Vidhan Sabha has 243 seats. 38 reserved for SC, 2 for Anglo-Indians (now discontinued by 104th Amendment).

questions.question_hi: किस योगिक का रासायनिक सूत्र NaCl है?
questions.explanation_en: • NaCl = Sodium Chloride = Common Salt. Ionic compound. Essential for human body. Used in food preservation.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'वित्तीय आपातकाल' किस अनुच्छेद से?
questions.explanation_en: • Art 360: Financial Emergency. Never declared in India's history. President can reduce salaries of govt employees.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का 'अररिया' जिला किसके लिए जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Araria: flood-prone district in Kosi river basin. Major crops: rice, wheat, jute. Border with Nepal.

questions.question_hi: 'ब्लीचिंग पाउडर' का रासायनिक सूत्र?
questions.explanation_en: • Bleaching powder = Calcium hypochlorite Ca(OCl)Cl. Used for water purification and bleaching textiles.

questions.question_hi: 'टीपू सुल्तान' किस राज्य के शासक थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Tipu Sultan = 'Tiger of Mysore'. Ruler of Mysore (1782-1799). Fought 4 Anglo-Mysore Wars. Died at Seringapatam.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'पंचायती राज दिवस' कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • National Panchayati Raj Day: April 24. Panchayati Raj instituted on April 24, 1993 (73rd Amendment came into force).

questions.question_hi: 'मायोपिया' (निकट दृष्टि दोष) में कैसा लेंस प्रयोग होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Myopia (nearsightedness): Concave (diverging) lens used. Image forms before retina. Corrected by pushing image back.

questions.question_hi: 'लोकसभा अध्यक्ष' (Speaker) के बारे में सही कथन?
questions.explanation_en: • Lok Sabha Speaker elected by members from among themselves. Presides over proceedings. Casting vote in tie.

questions.question_hi: 'बिहार' नाम किस शब्द से आया?
questions.explanation_en: • 'Bihar' from 'Vihara' (Buddhist monastery). Region had many Buddhist monasteries. Name evolved to Bihar.

questions.question_hi: किस रक्त समूह वाला व्यक्ति 'सार्वभौमिक दाता' है?
questions.explanation_en: • O negative = Universal Donor (no A, B antigens). AB positive = Universal Recipient. Blood typing critical for transfusion.

questions.question_hi: कौन सा देश 'उगते सूरज का देश' कहलाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Japan = 'Land of the Rising Sun' (Nippon = origin of sun). Easternmost country in Asia.

questions.question_hi: 'पूना पैक्ट' (1932) किनके बीच हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Poona Pact (Sept 1932): Gandhi and Ambedkar. Replaced separate electorate for Depressed Classes with reserved seats. Gandhi's fast.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'ICDS' (Integrated Child Development Services) का उद्देश्य?

options.hi: बच्चों और माताओं का पोषण और विकास

questions.explanation_en: • ICDS: nutrition, health checkup, pre-school education for 0-6 years children and pregnant/lactating women.

questions.question_hi: 'पास्कल का नियम' किससे संबंधित?
questions.explanation_en: • Pascal's Law: pressure applied to confined fluid is transmitted equally. Basis of hydraulic machines, brakes.

questions.question_hi: भारत के किस अनुच्छेद में 'उच्च न्यायालयों' का प्रावधान?
questions.explanation_en: • Articles 214-231 deal with High Courts. Art 214: HC for each state. Art 217: appointment. Art 226: writ jurisdiction.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का 'चंपारण' क्षेत्र किसके उत्पादन के लिए जाना जाता था?
questions.explanation_en: • Champaran was major indigo cultivation area under British. Tinkathia system forced farmers to grow indigo.

questions.question_hi: 'कॉपर सल्फेट' (Copper Sulphate) का उपनाम?
questions.explanation_en: • CuSO₄·5H₂O = Neela Thotha (Blue Vitriol). Used in electroplating, fungicide, school labs.

questions.question_hi: 'अगस्त प्रस्ताव' (August Offer) कब?
questions.explanation_en: • August Offer 1940: Viceroy Linlithgow's proposal for Dominion Status after WWII. Rejected by Congress and Muslim League.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सड़क सुरक्षा' के लिए कौन सा कानून?
questions.explanation_en: • MV Act (Central) and Bihar Motor Vehicle Taxation Act (State) both govern road safety and vehicle regulation.

questions.question_hi: 'हृदय गति' (Heart Rate) सामान्यतः कितनी होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Normal resting heart rate: 72-80 beats per minute (adult). Athletes may have lower (40-60). >100 = tachycardia.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'मतदान का अधिकार' किस प्रकार का अधिकार है?
questions.explanation_en: • Right to vote is LEGAL/STATUTORY right (not fundamental). Under Representation of People Act 1951. Art 326.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'तिलका मांझी' कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Tilka Manjhi (1750-1785) — first Indian to rebel against British. Paharia tribal. Shot arrow at Augustus Cleveland. Hanged 1785.

questions.question_hi: किस खनिज को 'मूर्खों का सोना' (Fool's Gold) कहते हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Iron Pyrite (FeS₂) = Fool's Gold — looks like gold but is iron sulfide. Metallic luster, pale brass-yellow.

questions.question_hi: 'पीर पंजाल' पर्वत श्रेणी कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Pir Panjal Range: part of lesser Himalayas in J&K. Separates Kashmir Valley from plains. Pir Panjal Pass, Banihal Pass.

questions.question_hi: 'कलकत्ता मदरसा' की स्थापना किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • Warren Hastings established Calcutta Madrasa (1781) for study of Arabic and Persian. Later reformed.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'खगड़िया' जिला किसके लिए जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Khagaria: flood-prone district at confluence of Ganga, Kosi, Gandak. Agriculture-based economy. Major jute area.

questions.question_hi: 'प्रोटॉन' की खोज किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • Ernest Rutherford discovered proton (1919). Gold foil experiment (1911) also led to nuclear model of atom.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अनुसूचित क्षेत्र' (Scheduled Areas) किस अनुसूची में?
questions.explanation_en: • 5th Schedule: Scheduled Areas (tribal areas except NE). 6th Schedule: tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मोकामा ताल' किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation_en: • Mokama Tal: vast low-lying area in Patna-Lakhisarai. Seasonal wetland. Rabi crops after flood water recedes.

questions.question_hi: 'प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस' का रासायनिक सूत्र?
questions.explanation_en: • Plaster of Paris: CaSO₄·½H₂O (Calcium Sulphate Hemihydrate). Used in casts, moulds, construction.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'प्रथम स्वतंत्रता संग्राम' किस वर्ष?
questions.explanation_en: • 1857 Revolt (Sepoy Mutiny/First War of Independence). Started at Meerut May 10. Multi-cause uprising.

questions.question_hi: बिहार सरकार की 'हर खेत को पानी' योजना किससे संबंधित?
questions.explanation_en: • 'Har Khet Ko Pani' — irrigation to every field. Part of PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana. Bihar focuses on minor irrigation.

questions.question_hi: 'वायुमंडलीय दाब' का SI मात्रक?
questions.explanation_en: • Pascal (Pa) is SI unit of pressure. 1 atm = 101,325 Pa. Measured by barometer (invented by Torricelli).

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग' (CVC) का गठन?
questions.explanation_en: • Central Vigilance Commission established 1964 (based on Santhanam Committee). Statutory status 2003. Anti-corruption.

questions.question_hi: बिहार का 'राजगृह' (Rajgir) किसकी राजधानी थी?
questions.explanation_en: • Rajgir (Rajagriha) was capital of Magadha under Haryanka dynasty (Bimbisara, Ajatashatru). Before Pataliputra.

questions.question_hi: 'इलेक्ट्रोलिसिस' (Electrolysis) में कैथोड पर क्या होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Cathode: Reduction (gain of electrons). Anode: Oxidation (loss of electrons). Remember: RED CAT (Reduction at Cathode).

questions.question_hi: 'हिमालय' किस प्रकार के पर्वत हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Himalayas are Fold Mountains — formed by collision of Indian and Eurasian tectonic plates (~50 million years ago).

questions.question_hi: 'चार धाम' तीर्थ में कौन शामिल नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: • Char Dham: Badrinath (North), Jagannath Puri (East), Rameswaram (South), Dwarka (West). Varanasi is not in Char Dham.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सुशासन' (Good Governance) का नारा किसने दिया?
questions.explanation_en: • Nitish Kumar — 'Sushasan Babu' (Mr. Good Governance). His governance model focused on law & order, development.

questions.question_hi: 'टिटनस' (Tetanus) का कारक क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tetanus: Clostridium tetani bacteria. Enters through wounds. Produces toxin causing muscle spasms. Prevented by TT vaccine.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'नागरिकता संशोधन अधिनियम' (CAA) कब पारित?
questions.explanation_en: • CAA passed Dec 11, 2019. Provides citizenship to persecuted minorities from Pak, BD, Afghanistan. Rules notified March 2024.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सोनपुर' का ऐतिहासिक महत्व?

options.hi: हरिहर क्षेत्र (गंगा-गंडक संगम) और पशु मेला

questions.explanation_en: • Sonepur: at Ganga-Gandak confluence. Harihar Kshetra temple. Asia's largest cattle fair (Sonepur Mela) on Kartik Purnima.

questions.question_hi: 'सीमेंट' बनाने में मुख्य कच्चा माल?
questions.explanation_en: • Cement: Limestone (CaCO₃) + Clay (silica, alumina). Heated in kiln to make clinite. Portland Cement most common.

questions.question_hi: 'रेग्युलेटिंग एक्ट' कब पारित?
questions.explanation_en: • Regulating Act 1773: first step of British Parliament to control Company. Created Governor-General of Bengal. Set up Supreme Court in Calcutta.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बहुत कम वन क्षेत्र' होने का मुख्य कारण?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar has only ~7% forest cover due to: high population density, agricultural expansion, historical deforestation.

questions.question_hi: 'आर्किमिडीज का सिद्धांत' किससे संबंधित?
questions.explanation_en: • Archimedes' Principle: buoyant force = weight of displaced fluid. Explains why ships float, hot air balloons rise.

questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान कब लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation_en: • Constitution came into force Jan 26, 1950 (Republic Day). Adopted Nov 26, 1949. India became sovereign republic.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'विक्रमशिला विश्वविद्यालय' किस वंश ने स्थापित किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Pala dynasty — Dharmapala founded Vikramashila (~783 CE). Major Buddhist learning center. Atisha taught here.

questions.question_hi: 'कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड' (CO) विषाक्त क्यों है?

options.hi: हीमोग्लोबिन से बंधकर O₂ वहन रोकती है

questions.explanation_en: • CO binds to hemoglobin 200× more strongly than O₂. Forms carboxyhemoglobin → prevents oxygen transport → suffocation.

questions.question_hi: भारत में सबसे ऊँची चोटी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation_en: • K2 is in PoK. Kanchenjunga (8,586m) — highest peak entirely within India (Sikkim border). 3rd highest globally.

questions.question_hi: 'अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा' की स्थापना कब?
questions.explanation_en: • All India Kisan Sabha founded 1936 in Lucknow. President: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati (from Bihar). Peasant movement.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana' का लाभ?
questions.explanation_en: • PMFBY: crop insurance scheme. Covers natural calamities, pests. Low premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi). Bihar opted out 2018, rejoined.

questions.question_hi: 'जेनेटिकली मॉडिफाइड' (GM) फसल का एक उदाहरण?
questions.explanation_en: • Bt Cotton: genetically modified with Bacillus thuringiensis gene. Produces toxin against bollworm. Only approved GM crop in India.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'राज्य विधायिका' में कौन शामिल?
questions.explanation_en: • State Legislature: Governor + Legislative Assembly + Legislative Council (in states that have it). Bihar has bicameral legislature.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'गंगा' नदी की सहायक नदियाँ (उत्तर से)?
questions.explanation_en: • North bank tributaries: Ghaghra, Gandak, Burhi Gandak, Bagmati, Kamla, Kosi, Mahananda. South: Son, Punpun, Phalgu.

questions.question_hi: 'DNA फिंगरप्रिंटिंग' का आविष्कार किसने किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Alec Jeffreys invented DNA fingerprinting (1984). Used in forensics, paternity testing, criminal investigation. Each person unique.

questions.question_hi: 'भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935' की विशेषता?
questions.explanation_en: • GOI Act 1935: Federal structure, Provincial autonomy, Federal Court. Basis of later Indian Constitution. 321 sections.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री उद्यमी योजना' किसके लिए?
questions.explanation_en: • CM Udyami Yojana: ₹10 lakh loan (50% subsidy) for SC/ST/OBC/Women to start enterprises. Promotes entrepreneurship.

questions.question_hi: 'पारसेक' (Parsec) किसकी इकाई है?
questions.explanation_en: • Parsec = astronomical distance unit. 1 parsec = 3.26 light years = 3.086 × 10¹³ km. Used for interstellar distances.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'सबसे अधिक बार' मौलिक अधिकारों पर प्रतिबंध?
questions.explanation_en: • During National Emergency (Art 352): Art 19 automatically suspended. Art 20-21 cannot be suspended (44th Amendment).

questions.question_hi: 'चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य' के गुरु कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Chanakya (Kautilya/Vishnugupta) mentored Chandragupta Maurya. Founded Maurya Empire. Wrote Arthashastra.

questions.question_hi: 'क्लोरोफॉर्म' (CHCl₃) का उपयोग?
questions.explanation_en: • Chloroform was early anesthetic. Also solvent. Now largely replaced by safer anesthetics due to toxicity.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'बंगाल की खाड़ी' किस तरफ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bay of Bengal is on India's east coast. Arabian Sea on west. Indian Ocean to south.

questions.question_hi: 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (Permanent Settlement) किसने लागू किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Lord Cornwallis: Permanent Settlement 1793 in Bengal-Bihar-Orissa. Fixed land revenue with Zamindars. Exploited peasants.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'शौचालय निर्माण' के लिए कौन सा अभियान?
questions.explanation_en: • Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin): toilet construction. Bihar achieved ODF (Open Defecation Free) status in many districts.

questions.question_hi: कौन सी किरण चुंबकीय क्षेत्र से विचलित नहीं होती?
questions.explanation_en: • Gamma rays are EM waves (no charge) — not deflected by electric/magnetic fields. Alpha (+) and Beta (-) are charged.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अल्पसंख्यक आयोग' अधिनियम कब?
questions.explanation_en: • National Commission for Minorities Act 1992. Statutory body. Safeguards rights of religious minorities.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'नौगछिया' किस जिले में?
questions.explanation_en: • Naugachia is a sub-division in Bhagalpur district. Located on Kosi river bank. Important agricultural area.

questions.question_hi: 'विषाणु' (Virus) की खोज किसने की?
questions.explanation_en: • Dmitri Ivanovsky discovered viruses (1892) from tobacco mosaic disease. Viruses: smaller than bacteria, need host cell.

questions.question_hi: 'पंजाब केसरी' किसे कहा गया?
questions.explanation_en: • Lala Lajpat Rai = 'Punjab Kesari/Lion of Punjab'. Led boycott of Simon Commission. Died after lathi charge 1928.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मधेपुरा' रेल इंजन कारखाना किस कंपनी का?
questions.explanation_en: • Madhepura Electric Locomotive Factory: Alstom (French). Manufactures 12,000 HP electric locomotives. India's most powerful.

questions.question_hi: किस धातु का गलनांक सबसे अधिक होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tungsten (W): highest melting point (3,422°C) of all metals. Used in bulb filaments and high-temperature applications.

questions.question_hi: भारत में कौन से राज्य में विधान परिषद नहीं है?
questions.explanation_en: • Rajasthan has no Legislative Council. States with LC: Bihar, UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra, Telangana.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'चौर' (Chaur) क्या है?
questions.explanation_en: • Chaur = oxbow lakes/waterlogged depressions. Formed by river meandering. Common in north Bihar. Used for fishing, mackhana.

questions.question_hi: 'W' किस राशि का SI मात्रक है?
questions.explanation_en: • Watt (W) = SI unit of Power. P = W/t. 1 Watt = 1 Joule/second. Named after James Watt.

questions.question_hi: 'भारत के लौह पुरुष' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel = 'Iron Man of India'. Integrated 562 princely states. First Deputy PM and Home Minister.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'NREGA/MGNREGA' का मुख्य उद्देश्य?
questions.explanation_en: • MGNREGA: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per household per year. Unskilled manual work. Demand-driven scheme.

questions.question_hi: पौधों में 'वाष्पोत्सर्जन' की दर किस समय अधिक?
questions.explanation_en: • Transpiration rate highest at noon — maximum temperature, wind, sunlight (stomata open wide). Minimum at night.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'दल-बदल विरोधी कानून' किस अनुसूची में?
questions.explanation_en: • Anti-Defection Law in 10th Schedule (52nd Amendment, 1985). Modified by 91st Amendment (2003). Speaker decides.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'गया' का धार्मिक महत्व?
questions.explanation_en: • Gaya: Pind Daan (ancestor rituals at Vishnupad Temple) and Bodh Gaya (Buddha's enlightenment). Major pilgrimage.

questions.question_hi: 'ऊतक' (Tissue) किसे कहते हैं?

options.hi: समान कोशिकाओं का समूह जो एक कार्य करे

questions.explanation_en: • Tissue = group of similar cells performing same function. Types: epithelial, connective, muscular, nervous.

questions.question_hi: 'लक्षद्वीप' किस महासागर में स्थित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Lakshadweep islands in Arabian Sea. 36 islands (10 inhabited). Coral atolls. Smallest UT of India by area.

questions.question_hi: 'वेदांत दर्शन' किससे संबंधित है?
questions.explanation_en: • Adi Shankaracharya (788-820 CE) propagated Advaita Vedanta philosophy. Established 4 mathas across India.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'अभ्यारण्य' (Wildlife Sanctuary) कितने हैं?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar has ~12 wildlife sanctuaries including Valmiki, Bhimbandh, Rajgir, Barela Jheel, Kanwarjheel etc.

questions.question_hi: 'परमाणु' का सबसे छोटा कण?
questions.explanation_en: • Quarks are smallest known particles — make up protons and neutrons. 6 types (flavors): up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'सर्वोच्च न्यायालय' की स्थापना कब?
questions.explanation_en: • Supreme Court established Jan 28, 1950. Replaced Federal Court. First CJI: H.J. Kania. 26 Tilak Marg, New Delhi.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'नवादा' जिले का मुख्य उत्पाद?
questions.explanation_en: • Nawada: major producer of rice, pulses, oilseeds. Also known for Kakolat Falls and ancient Pawapuri nearby.

questions.question_hi: 'संवहन' (Convection) किसमें होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Convection: heat transfer through fluid movement (liquids and gases). Example: boiling water, sea breeze.

questions.question_hi: 'कौटिल्य' किस साम्राज्य से जुड़े थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Kautilya (Chanakya) — chief advisor of Maurya Empire. Helped Chandragupta establish empire. Author of Arthashastra.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'सरकारी अस्पतालों' में मुफ्त दवा योजना?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar government provides free essential medicines in government hospitals under state free medicine distribution scheme.

questions.question_hi: 'न्यूक्लियर रिएक्टर' में 'मॉडरेटर' का कार्य?
questions.explanation_en: • Moderator (heavy water, graphite) slows down fast neutrons for sustained fission chain reaction in nuclear reactor.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'पहला संवैधानिक संशोधन' कब?
questions.explanation_en: • 1st Amendment 1951: added 9th Schedule. Restrictions on free speech for public order. Land reform laws protection.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'कर्पूरी ठाकुर' कौन थे?
questions.explanation_en: • Karpuri Thakur — CM of Bihar (1970-71, 1977-79). Champion of backward classes. 'Jan Nayak' (People's Leader). Bharat Ratna 2024.

questions.question_hi: 'डेसीबल' (dB) शून्य क्या दर्शाता है?

options.hi: मानव कान की सुनने की न्यूनतम सीमा

questions.explanation_en: • 0 dB = threshold of human hearing (not silence). Whisper ~20 dB, conversation ~60 dB, jet engine ~150 dB.

questions.question_hi: 'गोदावरी' नदी को दक्षिण की गंगा क्यों कहते हैं?

options.hi: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी

questions.explanation_en: • Godavari (1,465 km) — longest peninsular river. Called 'Dakshine Ganga'. Originates at Trimbak (Nasik). Sacred river.

questions.question_hi: 'हड़प्पा सभ्यता' की प्रमुख विशेषता?
questions.explanation_en: • Harappan Civilization: remarkable urban planning, grid roads, drainage system, Great Bath, standardized bricks and weights.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'शहरी विकास' के लिए कौन सी संस्था जिम्मेदार?
questions.explanation_en: • BUIDCO (Bihar Urban Infrastructure Development Corporation) handles urban development, housing, infrastructure projects.

questions.question_hi: 'समुद्री जल' में लवणता (Salinity) कितनी होती है?
questions.explanation_en: • Average ocean salinity: 35‰ (35 grams per liter). Highest: Red Sea, Mediterranean. Lowest: Baltic Sea.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अनुसूचित जनजाति' (ST) की सूची कौन तैयार करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • President specifies ST list under Art 342. Parliament can modify. Based on Registrar General's recommendation.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'रोहतास गढ़' किला कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Rohtasgarh Fort in Rohtas district — one of India's oldest hill forts. Built on Son River cliff. Used by Sher Shah Suri.

questions.question_hi: 'माइक्रोस्कोप' का आविष्कार किसने किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Antonie van Leeuwenhoek: Father of Microbiology. Invented practical microscope (~1674). First to observe bacteria, protozoa.

questions.question_hi: 'गोलमेज सम्मेलन' कितने हुए?
questions.explanation_en: • 3 Round Table Conferences (London): 1st-1930, 2nd-1931 (Gandhi attended), 3rd-1932. For Indian constitutional reform.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा' कहाँ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Gaya International Airport (Bodh Gaya) — international (Buddhist pilgrim traffic from SE Asia). Patna has commercial airport.

questions.question_hi: 'परमाणु ऊर्जा आयोग' (AEC) की स्थापना कब?
questions.explanation_en: • AEC established Aug 10, 1948. First chairman: Homi J. Bhabha. Governs India's nuclear program.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'सूचना का अधिकार' (RTI) में कितने दिनों में जवाब?
questions.explanation_en: • 30 days for normal requests. 48 hours for life/liberty matters. First appeal within 30 days to superior officer.

questions.question_hi: 'मुंगेर' (Monghyr) का प्राचीन इतिहास?

options.hi: अंग्रेज युग का शस्त्रागार और प्राचीन किला

questions.explanation_en: • Munger: ancient fortified city. British Gun Carriage Factory. Mir Qasim's capital. BSY (Bihar School of Yoga).

questions.question_hi: 'वायरस' जीवित है या निर्जीव?

options.hi: जीवित और निर्जीव के बीच (सीमा रेखा)

questions.explanation_en: • Viruses are on borderline of living and non-living. Show living characters only inside host cell. No metabolism on own.

questions.question_hi: 'मानसून' शब्द किस भाषा से आया?
questions.explanation_en: • Monsoon from Arabic 'Mausim' meaning season. Seasonal wind reversal bringing rain to South Asia.

questions.question_hi: 'त्रिपिटक' किस धर्म का ग्रंथ है?
questions.explanation_en: • Tripitaka (Three Baskets) — Buddhist scripture in Pali. Vinaya Pitaka, Sutta Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री विद्या लक्ष्मी योजना' किसके लिए?
questions.explanation_en: • Scholarship scheme for girl students pursuing higher education. Encourages girls' education in Bihar.

questions.question_hi: 'पराश्रव्य' (Ultrasonic) तरंगों की आवृत्ति?
questions.explanation_en: • Ultrasonic: >20,000 Hz (above human hearing). Infrasonic: <20 Hz. Audible: 20-20,000 Hz.

questions.question_hi: भारत के संविधान में 'समानता का अधिकार' किन अनुच्छेदों में?
questions.explanation_en: • Right to Equality: Art 14 (equality before law), 15 (non-discrimination), 16 (equal opportunity), 17 (untouchability abolished), 18 (titles abolished).

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बिहपुर' (Bihpur) किसके लिए जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihpur (Bhagalpur) known for jute production. Kosi river basin area. Agriculture-dependent economy.

questions.question_hi: 'लैक्टोज' (Lactose) किसमें पाया जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Lactose = milk sugar (disaccharide: glucose + galactose). Lactose intolerance common in adults (lack of lactase enzyme).

questions.question_hi: 'बुद्ध' के विषय में 'Tripitaka' में कौन सा Pitaka उनके उपदेशों का संग्रह है?
questions.explanation_en: • Sutta Pitaka contains Buddha's discourses/teachings. Vinaya = monastic rules. Abhidhamma = philosophical analysis.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'Smart City Mission' में कौन सा शहर शामिल?
questions.explanation_en: • Bhagalpur and Bihar Sharif selected under Smart City Mission. Focus on e-governance, water supply, transport, energy.

questions.question_hi: 'टेफ्लॉन' (Teflon) किसका बहुलक है?
questions.explanation_en: • Teflon = PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene). Non-stick coating. Heat resistant, chemically inert. Used in cookware, science.

questions.question_hi: भारत में 'अल्पसंख्यक' का निर्धारण कौन करता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Central Government notifies minorities under National Commission for Minorities Act. Currently 6: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis.

questions.question_hi: बिहार में 'बेगूसराय' को किस उपनाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Begusarai = 'Industrial Capital of Bihar'. Has IOCL Barauni refinery, thermal power, fertilizer plants.

questions.question_hi: 'ओम' (Ohm) किसकी इकाई है?
questions.explanation_en: • Ohm (Ω) = unit of electrical resistance. R = V/I. Named after Georg Simon Ohm. 1 Ohm = 1 Volt/Ampere.

questions.question_hi: 'कश्मीर' का इतिहास 'राजतरंगिणी' में किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation_en: • Kalhana wrote Rajatarangini (~1148 CE) — history of Kashmir kings. Major historical text in Sanskrit.

questions.question_hi: बिहार सरकार की 'सम्मान योजना' (Samman Yojana) किससे संबंधित?
questions.explanation_en: • Samman pension schemes: old age, widow, disability pensions. Monthly financial assistance to vulnerable groups.

questions.question_hi: 'प्रोटॉन' पर कितना आवेश होता है?
questions.explanation_en: • Proton charge: +1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ Coulombs. Electron has equal but opposite charge. Neutron is neutral (0 charge).

questions.question_hi: भारत का 'राष्ट्रीय ध्वज' किसने डिजाइन किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Pingali Venkayya designed the basis. Flag adopted July 22, 1947. Saffron-White-Green with Ashoka Chakra (24 spokes).

questions.question_hi: 'मधुबनी चित्रकला' (Mithila Painting) की विशेषता?
questions.explanation_en: • Madhubani Painting: natural dyes, geometric patterns, Hindu deities. Women's art form. GI tag. UNESCO recognition.

questions.question_hi: 'DNA' का पूर्ण रूप?
questions.explanation_en: • DNA = Deoxyribonucleic Acid. Carries genetic information. Double helix structure. A-T, G-C base pairing.

questions.question_hi: 'मैकमोहन रेखा' किन देशों के बीच है?
questions.explanation_en: • McMahon Line: India-China border (Arunachal Pradesh). Drawn 1914 at Simla Convention. China doesn't recognize it.

questions.question_hi: 'अशोक स्तंभ' पर कौन सा चिन्ह है?
questions.explanation_en: • Ashoka Pillar at Sarnath has Lion Capital (4 lions). Adopted as National Emblem of India. 'Satyameva Jayate' inscribed.

questions.question_hi: बिहार की 'साक्षरता दर' (Census 2011) लगभग कितनी?
questions.explanation_en: • Bihar literacy rate: 63.8% (2011 Census). Male: 73.4%, Female: 53.3%. Below national average (74%). Improvement ongoing.

questions.question_hi: 'टेलीस्कोप' (दूरबीन) का आविष्कार किसने किया?
questions.explanation_en: • Hans Lippershey invented telescope (1608, Netherlands). Galileo improved it (1609) for astronomical observations. Newton made reflector telescope.

questions.question_en: Which country hosted the COP28 preparatory summit in 2025?
questions.explanation_en: • COP28 was hosted by UAE (Dubai) in 2023; preparatory events in region continued in 2025.

questions.question_en: Assertion (A): Article 368 provides Parliament the power to amend the Constitution. Reason (R): Constitutional amendments require only a simple majority in Parliament.

options.en: Both A and R true, R explains A
Both true, R does not explain A

questions.explanation_en: • Article 368 grants amendment power but most amendments need special majority, not simple majority.

questions.question_en: Who led the 1857 revolt in Jagdishpur (Bihar)?
questions.explanation_en: • Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur was a key leader in Bihar during 1857.

questions.question_en: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
questions.explanation_en: • Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy (bleeding gums, poor wound healing).

questions.question_en: GDP deflator measures which of the following?
questions.explanation_en: • GDP deflator shows price level changes of all domestically produced goods and services.

questions.question_en: The Ganges forms which major delta?
questions.explanation_en: • The Ganges-Brahmaputra delta includes the Sundarbans in West Bengal and Bangladesh.

questions.question_en: Which Indian mission successfully tested on-orbit docking in Jan 2025?
